pub struct Resource
  handle: String
  digest: String
  size: i64
  verification: Verification

pub trait ContentReader
  type Error
  fn open(&self, digest: String) -> Result<OpenResult, Self::Error>
  fn read(&self, handle: String, offset: i64, max_bytes: i64) -> Result<ReadResult, Self::Error>
  fn close(&self, handle: String) -> Result<CloseResult, Self::Error>
pub struct ContentReaderClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait ContentWriter
  type Error
  fn begin(&self, request: String, digest: String, size: i64) -> Result<BeginResult, Self::Error>
  fn append(&self, handle: String, offset: i64, data: Vec<u8>) -> Result<AppendResult, Self::Error>
  fn commit(&self, handle: String) -> Result<CommitResult, Self::Error>
  fn abort(&self, handle: String) -> Result<AbortResult, Self::Error>
pub struct ContentWriterClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait ContentChanges
  type Error
  fn observe(&self, cursor: String, max_changes: i64, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<ChangePage, Self::Error>
  fn list(&self, continuation: String, limit: i64) -> Result<ListingPage, Self::Error>
pub struct ContentChangesClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Holds
  type Error
  fn hold(&self, request: String, target: String, purpose: String, lifetime: Lifetime, lease_ms: i64) -> Result<HoldResult, Self::Error>
  fn release(&self, hold: String) -> Result<ReleaseResult, Self::Error>
  fn renew(&self, hold: String, lease_ms: i64) -> Result<RenewResult, Self::Error>
pub struct HoldsClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Manifests
  type Error
  fn describe(&self, id: String) -> Result<DescribeResult, Self::Error>
  fn publish(&self, request: String, manifest: Manifest) -> Result<PublishResult, Self::Error>
pub struct ManifestsClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Inventory
  type Error
  fn list(&self, continuation: String, limit: i64) -> Result<InventoryPage, Self::Error>
  fn holders(&self, target: String) -> Result<InventoryPage, Self::Error>
  fn unheld(&self, continuation: String, limit: i64) -> Result<InventoryPage, Self::Error>
  fn find(&self, digest: String) -> Result<InventoryPage, Self::Error>
pub struct InventoryClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait ContentRemover
  type Error
  fn remove(&self, target: String) -> Result<RemoveResult, Self::Error>
pub struct ContentRemoverClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait InventorySource
  type Error

  fn snapshot(&self, continuation: String, limit: i64) -> Result<SourcePage, Self::Error>
  fn observe(&self, cursor: String, max_changes: i64, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<SourcePage, Self::Error>
  fn verify(&self, target: String) -> Result<SourcePage, Self::Error>
  fn remove(&self, target: String) -> Result<RemoveResult, Self::Error>

  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
